features.label: Rage rebuilt into composure
features.detail: Was a racket-smashing teenager. The calm was constructed deliberately, not innate temperament.

features.label: Efficiency over power
features.detail: Built a game around economy of motion, which is why it survived into his forties.

features.label: Longevity is the lesson
features.detail: Twenty-four years professional. The question worth asking is about maintenance, not talent.
